_about: Crop boxes for tools/images.py all. crop = x,y,w,h in source pixels (4:5). frac crops are fractions of the image and survive a higher-resolution source.

hero.ceiling_note: Fraction of the photo's height, from the top, that is only ceiling (the highest head starts at about 0.215). Wide screens may crop this much and no more; anything wider gets margins. Re-measure if the photo changes.

portraits.note: The club’s own photo from his visit (Oct 29, 2026), in front of the Dartmouth backdrop; cropped to him alone. Eyes at about 40%, head about 57% of the frame. The original is 8064 × 4536, so the crop has room to spare.
